_comment: Copy to policy.json to widen or narrow the approved estate. This file is read by the plugin but is NOT editable from the web form: keep it root-owned (chown root:root, chmod 0644) so a compromised web session can only choose between values you already approved. Every key is optional; anything omitted falls back to the built-in FPP 10 defaults.
_host_allowlist_comment: Exact hosts, CIDR blocks, or dotted DNS suffixes. A bare substring never matches, and a /0 block is refused.
_viewer_rendition_comment: The viewer-rendition lane (README: Viewer rendition lane). Disabled unless enabled here. The encoder must also be listed in allowed_binaries. Both roots must be outside every web root, outside the music/upload roots, the media-supply root and the key roots, and disjoint from each other. The rid key file holds 64 lowercase hex characters, mode 0600, inside a key root.
